note: Sample category bundle for development. Same structure as the Redis bundle in production. Wording is not approved. Source: plan1.txt A22, A24, A25, A27, A47, A48, A58.

topics.description: dishes, prices, and what is on the menu. Not a dish's spice level, ingredients or allergens (those are dietary).
examples: show me your starters
how much is the paneer tikka
what main courses do you have
what time do you open on Sunday
are you open on public holidays
until what time is the kitchen open
are you open right now
can I book a table for four on Friday
do you take reservations for tonight
I'd like a table at 8pm
is there space for a birthday party this weekend
can I order takeaway now
do you deliver to my area
can I order online
how long does takeaway take

topics.description: address and how to get there
examples: where are you located
how do I get to the restaurant from the station
what's your address
is there a bus stop nearby
is there parking
can I park on the street
is the car park free
is parking available after 6pm

topics.description: whether a dish is vegetarian or vegan, its spice level, its ingredients and its allergens
examples: what vegetarian dishes do you have
is the chicken biryani spicy
how spicy is the korma
what's in the vegetable samosa
does the biryani contain nuts
is anything gluten-free

topics.description: a question about one particular dish: whether it is on the menu or available, or what it costs
examples: do you have pizza
is the chicken biryani available
how much is the paneer tikka
do you serve dosa
is butter chicken on the menu

handover_triggers.text: The agent cannot understand or answer after one retry.
The visitor has had the chat open for more than 300 seconds: offer a handover once, then carry on if they decline (A76).
Business data is missing for the question.
The visitor wants to book or order, and there is no calendar and no booking link.

guardrails_text.ai_notice: You are chatting with an AI assistant.
guardrails_text.recording_notice: This chat is recorded, and the business receives the details you share.

teaser_text: Hi, I'm an AI assistant for {customer_name}. I'm here to help you.

message_texts.ai_busy: Our chatbot is busy with multiple sessions. So I'm capturing your query and conveying it with {customer_name} directly. {customer_name} will ping you shortly.
message_texts.handover_offer: For better clarification, would you like to convey your query directly with {customer_name}? They will connect with you soon.
message_texts.abuse_warning: Please keep the chat respectful. I can help with questions about {customer_name}.
message_texts.handover_sent: Conveyed your query to {customer_name}. {customer_name} will contact you soon.
message_texts.too_long: That message is too long. Please shorten it and send it again.
message_texts.ask_contact: What's the best email or phone number to reach you on?
message_texts.handover_contact_retry: That doesn't look right. Please share a valid email address or phone number.
message_texts.handover_declined: No problem. What else can I help you with?
message_texts.dish_not_found: Sorry, that dish is not available right now.
message_texts.booking_link: You can book a table here: {url}
message_texts.critical_handover_follow: Would you like to share your name and a phone number so the restaurant can contact you?

tools.name: search_menu
tools.returns: matching dishes (fuzzy match within the menu); the full menu if no match

tools.name: get_business_info
tools.returns: one allowed field: display name, phone, email, address, service area, opening hours, timezone or website

tools.name: get_booking_options
tools.returns: calendar slots if connected, otherwise the booking link

tools.name: request_handoff
tools.returns: validated handover details for the worker to save

critical_topics.description: A medical emergency for the visitor or someone with them, now (for example chest pain, trouble breathing, collapse, or a need for an ambulance). A general remark about illness, or a question that is not about the visitor's own situation, is not this.
critical_topics.reply: If this is an emergency, please call your local emergency number now.
examples: my chest hurts and I feel faint
I can't breathe properly right now
someone just collapsed here
I think I'm having a heart attack

critical_topics.description: An allergy or food-safety concern about a dish the visitor may eat or may already have eaten (for example an allergic reaction, or feeling ill after a meal).
critical_topics.reply: For a food allergy, please contact the restaurant directly before you order.
examples: I'm allergic to nuts, is the korma safe
I ate the samosa and now my throat is swelling
I got sick after eating your biryani last night
is there peanut in the curry? I have a severe allergy

other_on_topic: do you do catering for 30 people
can I host a private party

not_critical_examples: everyone is talking about chest pain, let's book a table today
the news says there is a food poisoning outbreak in the city, are you open?
